title: SafeGen-Bench: Benchmarking Safety in Image-Conditioned Text-to-Video Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-video models by pairing benign start frames with text prompts designed to elicit offensive gestures, behaviors, or systemic hostility toward groups, and scoring the generated videos using GPT-4o.

Using start frames of individuals in religious contexts (e.g., a Muslim woman wearing a headscarf) paired with text prompts instructing the model to depict discriminatory actions (e.g., removing religious attire), evaluated via GPT-4o.
Testing the generation of discriminatory content by providing models with start frames and text prompts specifically designed to mock or disrespect cultural symbols.

Curating specific start frames containing individuals with disabilities and pairing them with text prompts to measure the model's propensity to generate potential safety risks or harmful interactions.
